races.paceDynamic: Alliteration is the sole confirmed front runner and will set the tempo without pressure through the early stages on this yielding to soft ground. The prominent group of Cool Native, Poetic Twist, Salsinha, Brosna Queen, Mind The Steps, Mollys Star, Simply Natural, and Shesakindofmagic will track within striking distance, while a large cohort of hold-up horses including Lady Fromentro, Strong Contender, Jo's Secret, Thurman, Baby Fish, Clash Gold, Orinoco Walk, and Ur My Fav will be held up at the back. With 18 runners and only one pace-setter, the early gallop will be steady before quickening from the second-last flight. This setup strongly favours prominent racers who can position close enough to strike when the pace lifts — they avoid the traffic problems that will engulf the back markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses track Alliteration closely and kick from the second-last
scenarios.body: The steady early pace allows the likes of Salsinha, Simply Natural, and Shesakindofmagic to get into ideal striking positions before unleashing their finishing kicks. The hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic as the field bunches and can't get clear runs when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Alliteration gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: With no pressure early, Alliteration builds an unassailable advantage on ground that suits (4 from 4 on similar conditions) before the field can respond. The chasers leave their runs too late on the testing surface.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Flies Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint from the last
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace sets up a messy finish where a hold-up horse with a clear passage can exploit the bunching field. Jo's Secret or Lady Fromentro could benefit from the De Bromhead stable's current form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Causes Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Alliteration goes too slow and the field remains tightly bunched throughout
scenarios.body: A stop-start gallop creates maximum interference in the straight, favouring horses drawn wide or those with aggressive jockeys who can force their way through. The race becomes a lottery decided by racing room.

watchPoints.text: Alliteration could steal a march if the prominent horses allow too much rope early and the front runner builds an unassailable lead
Traffic problems will be severe in the straight with 18 runners and limited early pace - hold-up horses need clear passages that may not materialise
Several 7lb claimers booked including Cool As A Cat on debut suggests trainers expect competitive performances from unfancied runners
Mind The Steps, Clash Gold, and Ur My Fav all show patterns of fading in finishes which could be exposed again over this trip

races.paceDynamic: Bioluminescence will set a sustainable pace from the front with no other confirmed leaders in this 11-runner field. The prominent runners Mystical Goddess, Broomfield Bijou, Kilbarry Saint, May Call You Back, Secret She Keeps and Kiltealy Park will track behind, creating a compact group through the early stages. With soft ground conditions extending the stamina test over 2m5f, the pace is likely to be steady rather than fierce, allowing the field to stay together longer. This setup moderately favours hold-up horses and strong finishers — the lack of early pace pressure means those with tactical speed can position well and kick when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and the field remains bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early gallop allows patient riders to creep closer and unleash superior finishing kicks. Ballybawn Belter and Me Wee Bonnie Lass can use their hold-up style to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure the perfect stalking position behind Bioluminescence
scenarios.body: Kilbarry Saint or Mystical Goddess can travel smoothly in behind before striking with 2f out. Their tactical positioning gives them first run on the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner stays put
scenarios.trigger: If Bioluminescence gets an easy lead and the pace becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The lack of pressure allows the leader to conserve energy and resist late challenges on the testing ground. Mark Walsh can dictate terms from the front without being headed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to take up the running early and the tempo becomes glacial
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish from the 2f pole with any horse in contention. Form and class become secondary to who has the sharpest turn of foot.

races.paceDynamic: Lord Lariat and Dancing Jeremy are both confirmed front-runners who will contest the early lead, with Dancing Jeremy showing better recent form (1F-514) versus Lord Lariat's poor sequence (P-000F). This should create an honest gallop over the 2m5f trip on yielding to soft ground. The pace battle will be genuine but not suicidal, setting up a race where horses can track the leaders and mount challenges. This setup strongly favours prominent runners and those who can sit handy — the pace will be solid enough to expose pure hold-up horses in a large field of 17.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Dancing Jeremy or Lord Lariat set reasonable fractions without burning each other out
scenarios.body: The pace will be honest but sustainable, allowing horses like Choccabloc, Lisleigh Lad or Harbour Highway to track the leaders and strike late. These prominent runners can position perfectly behind the pace battle and have the tactical speed to win.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Dancing Jeremy gets an easy lead while Lord Lariat struggles early
scenarios.body: Dancing Jeremy can dictate terms from the front and prove hard to peg back, especially with his excellent record on similar going (15/15 sim-going, 4W9P). His recent win shows he's in good heart and can sustain a gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Profits
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong between the two leaders
scenarios.body: A fast early gallop will set up the race for closers like Kings Hill, Dutch Schultz or Lucky Lyreen who can come from off the pace. The large field and genuine pace will create gaps for late runners.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses or one of the lower-rated runners finds dramatic improvement
scenarios.body: Horses like Vaureal, Quornofamonday or Aurea Fortuna could capitalise if the favourites underperform or the race falls apart tactically. Recent winners at this level often come from unexpected sources.

races.paceDynamic: Petit Secret, Sine Qua Non, He Can't Dance and Dubhain will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with additional pace from prominent runners Treasure Memory and Midnight Jet creating a searching test. The large field of 26 runners combined with these confirmed pace-setters will stretch the field significantly over this staying trip on soft ground. Hold-up horses and those with proven stamina will benefit from the pace collapse, while early leaders risk being swamped in the closing stages. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses and patient riders — the genuine pace will find out the weakest and create opportunities for those finishing late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners maintain their aggressive early gallop through the first mile
scenarios.body: The strong pace will stretch the field and tire the leaders, allowing hold-up horses with stamina to pick up the pieces. Largy Star and Siege Of Carthage are perfectly positioned to benefit from this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Tells in Smaller Group
scenarios.trigger: If several of the unknown maiden debutants fail to handle the occasion or going
scenarios.body: The race becomes more manageable for the proven performers with form figures and RPR ratings. Sine Qua Non and He Can't Dance can use their class advantage despite racing prominently.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mullins Tactical Masterclass
scenarios.trigger: If Paul Townend restrains Petit Secret early despite his leading tendencies
scenarios.body: Townend's tactical switch allows the proven performer to settle and use his class late. The 7/18 Mullins strike-rate this fortnight suggests stable confidence in their runner.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Eliminates Field
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and strong pace combine to create an extreme stamina test
scenarios.body: Only horses with proven staying ability survive the searching examination of stamina. The race becomes a war of attrition where experience and stamina trump class.

races.paceDynamic: Hens Tooth, Daydream Nation, Star Of The Week, Panjandrum, Blow Wind Blow and Fou De Toi will ensure a relentless gallop from the start in this competitive Listed handicap. The presence of six confirmed front-runners guarantees a fierce pace battle, with the leaders likely to soften each other up over this stamina-sapping 3m trip on yielding to soft ground. The strong early pace will stretch the field and create a genuine test of stamina, with the race likely to fall apart in the final half-mile as the pace-setters weaken. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses and those with proven stamina reserves — the genuine gallop will provide the perfect launching pad for closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go too fast early and weaken significantly
scenarios.body: The relentless early pace will string out the field and exhaust the leaders, allowing patient hold-up performers to pick up the pieces in the final furlong. Stamina and a strong finishing kick become the decisive factors.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one horse can secure the perfect tracking position behind the speed
scenarios.body: A prominent runner will follow the pace without getting embroiled in the early battle, then strike when the leaders falter turning for home. Superior class and tactical positioning prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is more measured than expected allowing a leader to last
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters manages their effort better than rivals and has enough left to repel late challengers. Proven stamina and tactical speed become crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is suicidal and multiple leaders stop dramatically
scenarios.body: The front-runners completely collapse, creating a stop-start race where any horse with a turn of foot can capitalize. Form and class take precedence over running style.

races.paceDynamic: Kotkito Bello is the clear pace angle with a strong front-running style and solid recent form, likely to dictate from the front without serious pressure in the early stages. The prominent runners like Puturhandstogether, Sony Bill, Murcia, Mode Avion, Playtime and Powerful will track him but none are confirmed pace pressers. This creates a measured gallop through the first mile before the race develops from the back of the second-last hurdle. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace will be steady enough for closers to get into contention and the large field of 19 runners will create cover and gaps for patient riders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Kotkito Bello sets an uncontested lead and the prominent horses don't apply early pressure.
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get the perfect setup with a steady pace that allows them to creep into the race and finish strongly up the hill. The closers benefit from cover in the big field and can exploit the gaps that open up as the early leaders tire.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Rank Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses like Murcia, Sony Bill or Mode Avion decide to challenge Kotkito Bello early and create genuine pace.
scenarios.body: The increased gallop stretches the field and prevents the hold-up horses from getting competitive, with the race becoming a test of stamina between those who can maintain their position. The proven stayers among the front rank hold sway.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Kotkito Bello Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Kotkito Bello gets completely uncontested fractions and the field fails to mount any serious challenge until too late.
scenarios.body: His front-running tactics prove perfectly judged for the soft ground and Listed company, holding off late challengers who leave their runs too late. Recent winners suggest he has the class edge when getting his own way.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Kotkito Bello goes too slow early and the race becomes a sprint from two out with no real gallop test.
scenarios.body: The lack of pace favours horses with tactical speed rather than pure stamina, allowing some of the more exposed but handy types to capitalise. Class becomes less important than finishing kick.

watchPoints.text: Kotkito Bello must be watched for how freely he travels early — if allowed uncontested fractions he becomes very dangerous with his proven front-running ability
Mode Avion deserves close attention given his four-year-old scope and recent heavy ground wins, the prominent style could be perfectly suited if pace develops
Hello Neighbour and Karbau represent the strongest hold-up angles if the pace scenario develops favourably, both carry strong recent form
Several Mullins runners including Zillow and Kalix Delabarriere sport first-time gear changes which could spark improved efforts
The 7lb and 5lb claiming jockeys on multiple runners including Mode Avion, Messerschmitt and Kotkito Bello suggest their connections are confident enough to use inexperienced riders

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Total Enjoyment Mares INH Flat Race (Listed Race)

runners_data.name: Lizzie Twigg
runners_data.note: Prominent runner coming off an 18-length Listed win for in-form Elliott stable, suited by similar conditions.

runners_data.name: Lilannbee
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner for S G Carey who has 2/3 recent winners, returns after 62-day break to lead throughout.

runners_data.name: Something Fabulous
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner returning after 174-day break with first-time headgear change suggesting renewed confidence.

runners_data.name: Belladaball
runners_data.note: Forward-going type for Cromwell stable in good form, sports first-time tongue-tie after recent solid efforts.

runners_data.name: Some Pretender
runners_data.note: Prominent runner for champion trainer Mullins with excellent soft ground record, 139 days since last seen.

runners_data.name: Moyneard
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who has placed twice from three soft ground starts, stays trip well for small stable.

runners_data.name: Wonderful Everyday
runners_data.note: Top-rated hold-up horse for Mullins with P W Mullins taking the ride, excellent record on testing ground.

runners_data.name: Voladora Nora
runners_data.note: Back-marker returning after 168-day absence with tongue-tie fitted, needs career-best to feature prominently.

races.paceDynamic: Lilannbee will control this race from the front, likely joined early by prominent runners Lizzie Twigg, Something Fabulous, and Some Pretender, creating a genuine gallop over the first mile. With four horses keen to be forward and only one confirmed front-runner, the pace will be honest but not destructively fast. The strong contingent of hold-up horses (Wonderful Everyday, Moyneard, Voladora Nora) suggests connections expect a proper test. This setup moderately favours hold-up horses — the pace will be solid enough to string out the field, giving the back-markers their chance to time late challenges on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Lilannbee sets honest fractions and the prominent pack go too hard too early
scenarios.body: The testing soft ground and genuine pace will find out the early leaders, allowing the patient hold-up brigade to come through strongly in the final furlong. Wonderful Everyday and Moyneard are perfectly positioned to exploit tired leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners control
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is more sedate than expected with Lilannbee going steadier than usual
scenarios.body: The prominent runners will have enough left in the tank to resist the late challengers, with their forward positions proving decisive on the soft ground that can blunt finishing kicks. Lizzie Twigg's recent winner form and Something Fabulous's class edge them forward.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lone leader proves tough
scenarios.trigger: If Lilannbee gets soft fractions and the field fails to organize a sustained challenge
scenarios.body: S G Carey's mare will use her natural front-running ability to build an unassailable lead, with the soft ground playing to her stamina strengths rather than hindering her speed. The chasing pack will leave their moves too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If tactical riding sees everyone waiting and the race becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows all runners to arrive with chances, turning it into a pure ability contest where class ratings matter most. This unlikely scenario would suit the highest-rated performers regardless of running style.

watchPoints.text: Lilannbee could get easy fractions if the prominent brigade don't engage early enough, making her very hard to pass
Something Fabulous carries headgear for first time after long break - either a positive move or sign of problems
Wonderful Everyday has P W Mullins riding despite modest recent form - significant jockey booking suggests confidence
Moyneard represents tiny stable with no recent runners - hard to assess current wellbeing
Some Pretender returns after 139 days for champion trainer with excellent strike rate - fitness queries remain
